asked.item: whether the 300-credit balance covers the planned batch of images
how to check the credit cost before generating

verdict.reason: The sentences give the nano-banana-pro credit cost and the rule for checking a balance against a whole job, which answers whether the planned batch fits the balance.

steps.text: The credit table lists nano-banana-pro at 50 credits per image, while the 1-credit cost is for flux schnell.
Before generating, compare your balance with the cost of the entire job, not one scene.
A positive balance still fails the check when the total cost is higher than the balance.
To see the credit cost of a generation, click a GREEN clip (image) and check the cost shown right above the Regenerate button.
